title: Clinic moves her treatment onto the mornings she grades in

life.summary: PhD student and teaching assistant on a monthly stipend; has a treatment at a hospital day clinic every 8 weeks and keeps the next day light

known.fact: Has a treatment at a day clinic every 8 weeks, about 4 hours; keeps the next day light (her own rule)
Routine: grades only in the morning, 8 AM to noon at her department desk; last term she finished 12 of 12 morning grading blocks and gave up on both afternoon ones
known.source: learned from last term's grading blocks

known.fact: Grading 60 lab reports takes her about 10 hours
known.source: learned from last term's grading blocks

known.fact: Routine: keeps weekends free unless she says otherwise
Doesn't want health details in anything sent to work

timeline.label: Morning at her desk, research (done today)
Treatment at the day clinic (moved here)

attached.label: Clinic portal: treatment moved from Tue Nov 24 to Wed Dec 2, 9 AM (about 4 hours)
Lab report grades due to the professor

dev_must_notice.what: The clinic moved her treatment to Wednesday Dec 2, 9 AM to 1 PM, right on top of grading block 3, two days before 60 lab-report grades are due Friday at 5 PM

She grades only in the mornings. With Wednesday gone and Thursday teaching, the mornings left before Friday 5 PM hold 8.5 of the 10 hours she needs: Monday 8 to 10, Tuesday 8 to 9 and 10:30 to noon, Friday 8 to noon
Her light day after the treatment is now Thursday Dec 3, the day she teaches both sections, the last of term

best_fix.what: Move what fits into her morning windows and say so with Undo: Monday 8 to 10, Tuesday 8 to 9 and 10:30 to noon, Friday 8 to noon, 8.5 hours. Then one question for the last 1.5 hours, with both options ready: a one-time Saturday Nov 28 morning, 9 to 10:30, or a draft asking the professor to take grades on Monday Dec 7 at noon instead, with no health details in it. In the same message: keep Thursday's teaching as is, or a draft asking a co-TA to cover section B.
best_fix.why: The clinic set the date, so the plan moves around it. Every block Dev places sits in the mornings she actually grades in, so she'll keep them. The gap can't be closed inside her routine without breaking a rule of hers (weekends, or the light day), so that choice is hers.

must_not: Put grading in an afternoon or evening, for example Wednesday after the treatment or Thursday afternoon; she grades only in the mornings
Put grading into the weekend without her yes
Mention her treatment or health in any draft to work
Grade, check or suggest marks for the lab reports
Suggest she skip or delay the treatment
Describe how she'll feel after the treatment beyond her own rule
assumptions: Day-clinic treatments of about 4 hours every 8 weeks; the clinic reschedules through its portal
The original plan was 10 hours: Monday 8 to 10, Tuesday 10:30 to noon, Wednesday 8 to noon, Friday 8 to 10:30
Times are Vancouver time; amounts are Canadian dollar cents
